step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents an analytics and data streaming architecture for Simpego. Customers interact with backend services hosted on EKS. Clickstream data is pushed from EKS through Kinesis Data Firehose into a RAW S3 bucket. AWS Glue performs incremental ETL transformation on the raw JSON data and stores the transformed data into another S3 bucket. Amazon Athena queries this data via Glue Crawlers, making it available to the Process Automation Engine to automate insurance processes and trigger data loops.

edges.notes: Customer web requests flow to backend on EKS.
EKS pushes clickstream events to Kinesis Firehose.
Firehose writes raw JSON data to RAW S3 bucket.
AWS Glue reads raw JSON data from S3.
AWS Glue writes processed data into second S3 bucket.
Athena queries processed dataset in S3 via Glue Crawler metadata.
Process Automation engine queries Athena for business insights and automation triggers.
